_comment: Emulated game network for the local stand. Checker addresses bypass blocking; team and admin addresses are the allowlist. Addresses are chosen by the operator, never learned from a request.
_network_comment: The 10.x ranges are placeholders for the real game network and are not yet reachable from this machine. The 127.x entries are what makes the stand usable on one host: 127.0.0.1 is the operator, 127.0.0.9 stands in for the checker, and 127.0.0.2 / 127.0.0.3 stand in for the two teams. Replace them with the real ranges when a grading client is pointed at the stand.

checker.note: grading client: passes through, never blocked
local stand stand-in for the checker, until a real grading client is pointed at it

admin.note: this machine, where the operator runs the stand

_routes_comment: Host -> upstream allowlist. The upstream is never taken from the request, so a crafted Host or X-Forwarded-Host cannot make the gateway fetch an arbitrary address.
